name: Ismail Naurdiev
summary: A sharp, busy kickboxer back in the UFC at middleweight, 2-1 since his return with a first-round KO of Ryan Loder; throws plenty of good strikes but can look aimless against a focused opponent.

how_they_fight.Striking: Throws a lot of sharp strikes; absorbs only about 2.5 a minute.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: 'Throwing out ideas and hoping for the best' (Sherdog).

concerns: Aimlessness against a clear game plan

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
